summary: @servicetitan/eslint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, unpacks it, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (marked `@bun @bun-cjs`, shuffled string-array decoder, `_0x`-style mangled identifiers, sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc). The payload is not referenced by the package's `main`/`dist` and would not execute under normal Node resolution; it only runs via the Bun runtime that setup.mjs fetches. This behavior is unrelated to the advertised purpose (an ESLint configuration package) and fires automatically on `npm install`, executing opaque attacker-shipped code on the installer's host under an alternate runtime that evades Node-focused inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
